nphi.title: JIHS–NUM MoU on infection research and crisis preparedness
nphi.with: Network of University Medicine (NUM, Charité-coordinated)

nphi.title: China CDC – NIID bilateral leaders meeting and technical exchange

nphi.title: China CDC – Japan NIID bilateral cooperation

nphi.summary: At a 2023 leaders' meeting, the two institutes agreed to build on their information sharing, technical exchange and joint research by setting up a regular technical exchange mechanism and personnel training on influenza, immunization…

nphi.title: JICA project: Improvement of safety and quality management systems at Noguchi (2022–2025)

nphi.title: SATREPS: antimicrobial resistance surveillance in Myanmar

nphi.title: SATREPS: HIV ART and prevention feedback system in Vietnam (NCGM)

nphi.title: PREPARE – Partnership for Building Resilience against Public Health Emergencies through Advanced Research and Education

nphi.title: SATREPS: rabies elimination network in the Philippines

nphi.summary: Oita University SATREPS project with RITM to build a network and diagnostics for rabies elimination in the Philippines.

nphi.title: Japan–Taiwan Symposium on emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases
nphi.with: Japanese infectious disease institutes (NIID)
nphi.summary: Recurring bilateral symposium (12th edition in 2016) on emerging and vaccine-preventable diseases and joint research projects between Taiwanese and Japanese public health experts.

nphi.title: NCGM–Lao National Institute of Public Health joint research and advisory support

nphi.title: Taiwan CDC – US CDC regional laboratory diagnosis trainings under the Global Cooperation and Training Framework
nphi.with: US CDC; national laboratories of South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: Series of regional laboratory trainings co-run by Taiwan CDC and US CDC under the GCTF, starting with MERS-CoV diagnostics in 2015 and followed by Zika, dengue/chikungunya and enterovirus courses for laboratory staff from Asia-Pacific…

nphi.title: SATREPS: surveillance and laboratory support for emerging pathogens in Ghana

nphi.title: NCGM–Myanmar Ministry of Health MoU

nphi.title: NCGM–Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine MoU

nphi.summary: Nagasaki University SATREPS project with KEMRI developing rapid diagnostics and an outbreak alert system for yellow fever and Rift Valley fever.

nphi.title: NCGM overseas base and MoUs with Bach Mai and Cho Ray hospitals

nphi.title: Field Epidemiology Training Program Japan (FETP-J)

nphi.title: NCGM–Cambodia National Maternal and Child Health Centre MoU
